subject: Starlite phased rollout: milestone cadence, owners, and escalation path
messages:
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>
To: Darla Reed <darla.reed@starlite.ai>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 30 Sep 2027 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: Starlite phased rollout: milestone cadence, owners, and escalation path

Hi Darla —

Thanks again for taking the call yesterday. As promised, I sketched a staggered rollout approach we think will reduce risk while keeping your team’s timelines. High-level plan attached (starlite_map_v1.xlsx) and a one-page cadence diagram.

Key points up front:
- Phase 1 (Pilot): one region, read-only ingestion + inference for the analytics team — 2 weeks
- Phase 2 (Integration): API integration with internal tools, canary traffic at 10% — 3 weeks
- Phase 3 (Scale): full production cutover + monitoring runbook — 2 weeks

We recommend the following owners from our side:
- Pilot lead: Monica Patel (CS) — test scripts, onboarding sessions
- Integration lead: Lauren Bishop (Solutions) — API keys, SDKs, developer support
- Production lead: Marcus Lin (Infra) — traffic gating, autoscale ops

Escalation path (if an SLO/issue during rollout):
1) Monica (CS) -> 2) Lauren (Solutions) -> 3) Marcus (Infra) -> 4) Rishi (Sales/exec)

Success criteria for go/no-go at each phase are in acceptance_criteria.md (attached). Can you confirm target dates for your side and whether procurement will need any additional artifacts?

If this looks good I’ll schedule a kick-off for next Wednesday and share the mutual action plan as an editable Drive doc.

Thanks,
Rishi Malhotra
Enterprise Account Executive
Redwood Inference

Attachments: starlite_map_v1.xlsx (spreadsheet), rollout_cadence_diagram.png (image), acceptance_criteria.md (markdown)
From: Darla Reed <darla.reed@starlite.ai>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>
Cc: Jae Kim <jae.kim@starlite.ai>, Procurement <procurement@starlite.ai>
Date: Thu, 30 Sep 2027 11:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Starlite phased rollout: milestone cadence, owners, and escalation path

Thanks Rishi — this is helpful. A few quick notes from our side:

- Pilot window: we prefer Oct 18–29 for Phase 1 (two weeks) to align with our quarterly data freeze.
- Integration: we can start API work the week of Nov 1, but our devs will only be available at 20% for the first two weeks (resource constraint).
- Production target: Nov 22 for full cutover if integration goes smoothly.

Procurement: we’ll need the SOC 2 questionnaire and a simple summary of data retention controls. Procurement copied here — can you route those docs?

Also, can the pilot be limited to anonymized data? Our legal team prefers that until SOC2 is validated.

Thanks — Darla
Director, Data Platforms
Starlite Analytics

Hi Darla / Procurement —

Copying the security/compliance team now. Monica — can you pull together the SOC 2 questionnaire and a one-page data retention summary and drop in the Drive link? We’ll propose anonymized ingestion for Phase 1 and document exactly what fields are masked.

Lauren — note the developer availability constraint (20% for first two weeks of Nov). Suggest we plan wider API pairing sessions on week 3 of Nov so we don’t delay the production target.

I’ll create the editable MAP with the dates Darla proposed and owners assigned. Marcus — please add the traffic gating steps (canary thresholds, rollback script names) into the runbook.

Rishi

Team —

I’m drafting the pilot test plan and the anonymization matrix today. Quick asks:
- Rishi: confirm if legal asked for any additional controls beyond masking (Pseudonymization vs full anonymization).
- Lauren: can you prepare a lightweight SDK sample that shows anonymized payloads by EOD Monday?
- Marcus: slot time to draft the rollback script and a checklist for the canary gate (I’ll add owners in the Drive doc).

I’ll attach the pilot script template to the drive link and ping Darla with the editable MAP when ready.

Monica Patel
Senior Customer Success Manager
Redwood Inference

Thanks everyone — quick update from engineering:

- Pilot confirmed for Oct 18–29 using anonymized data subset. We’ll provide test datasets by Oct 8.
- API team: limited availability noted; they can do two pairing sessions during week of Nov 8 and a final integration sprint Nov 15–19.
- Production go/no-go: we will evaluate on Nov 19 with a final freeze Nov 22 as Rishi outlined.

One risk: if the anonymization impacts model quality beyond a 5% hit, we will need an extension to integration time. Please include a contingency buffer in the MAP (we suggest 3 business days per phase).

I’ve added a brief note to the Drive MAP and attached the initial test dataset link.

— Jae
Senior Engineering Manager
Starlite Analytics
